description: This file contains utility implementations for testing the NetworkQualityEstimator class, including methods to simulate network conditions, retrieve network metrics, and manage test-specific behaviors within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: TestNetworkQualityEstimator
classes.description: A test subclass of NetworkQualityEstimator providing methods to simulate network conditions, retrieve metrics, and manage test-specific behaviors.

classes.name: LocalHttpTestServer
classes.description: A helper class for setting up a local HTTP server with default handlers for testing purposes.

methods.name: RunOneRequest
methods.description: Performs a single network request using the embedded test server to simulate network activity.

methods.name: SimulateNetworkChange
methods.description: Simulates a change in network connection type and network ID.

methods.name: GetEchoURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a simple echo page served by the embedded test server.

methods.name: GetRedirectURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a redirect page served by the embedded test server.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current effective connection type, possibly overridden for testing.

methods.name: GetRecentEffectiveConnectionTypeUsingMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent effective connection type along with associated metrics.

methods.name: GetRecentRTT
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent RTT measurement for a specified observation category.

methods.name: GetTransportRTT
methods.description: Returns the current transport RTT measurement.

methods.name: GetRecentDownlinkThroughputKbps
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent downlink throughput in Kbps.

methods.name: GetRTTEstimateInternal
methods.description: Returns an RTT estimate based on internal test data or default estimation.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of log entries of a specific type.

methods.name: GetNetLogLastStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last string value logged for a specific event type and key.

methods.name: GetNetLogLastIntegerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last integer value logged for a specific event type and key.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfRTTOrThroughputEstimatesComputed
methods.description: Notifies registered observers that RTT or throughput estimates have been computed.

methods.name: SetAndNotifyObserversOfEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Sets and notifies observers of a change in effective connection type.

methods.name: GetOverrideECT
methods.description: Returns an optional override for the effective connection type.

methods.name: SetAndNotifyObserversOfP2PActiveConnectionsCountChange
methods.description: Updates and notifies observers of the number of active P2P connections.

methods.name: RecordSpdyPingLatency
methods.description: Records the latency of a SPDY ping for a specific host.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the parameters used by the network quality estimator.

methods.name: GetCurrentNetworkID
methods.description: Returns the current network ID composed of network type and ID.

methods.name: LocalHttpTestServer
methods.description: Constructor for setting up a local HTTP server with default handlers.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfRTTOrThroughputComputed
methods.description: Notifies observers that RTT or throughput has been computed, respecting test suppression flags.

methods.name: NotifyRTTAndThroughputEstimatesObserverIfPresent
methods.description: Notifies a specific observer if present, respecting test suppression flags.

methods.name: SetStartTimeNullHttpRtt
methods.description: Sets a specific RTT value for HTTP and recomputes effective connection type.

methods.name: SetStartTimeNullTransportRtt
methods.description: Sets a specific RTT value for transport and recomputes effective connection type.
